excluded_gold.description: The GetWebAssets function implements an incomplete double-checked locking pattern for caching web assets. The function first checks if the cache is populated using a read lock (RLock), and if the cache is empty, it acquires a write lock to populate it. However, it fails to re-check whether the cache was populated by another goroutine while waiting to acquire the write lock.

adjudication.why: The missing second cache check may repeat manifest parsing under cold-start concurrency; it does not invalidate the pointer publication lock. Efficiency is outside the correctness lane.

excluded_gold.description: In addition to the missing double-check, the function has a critical flaw in its error handling: it unconditionally assigns the fetch result to the cache (line 69: entryPointAssetsCache = result) regardless of whether the fetch succeeded or failed. When an error occurs during asset fetching, result is nil, and this nil value overwrites any previously valid cache entry.

adjudication.why: Assigning result to the global cache on the error path is unchanged. The patch introduces locks around the existing assignment rather than a new cache-wipe behavior.
